tools.name: list_economies
tools.description: List modelled economies and aggregates with the current-quarter GDP nowcast (% q/q SAAR) and share of world GDP.

tools.name: get_nowcast
tools.description: Current GDP nowcast for one economy: headline (% SAAR), 70% range, days to official release, recent daily path, component contributions and the latest data releases that moved it.

tools.name: get_aggregate
tools.description: World or regional GDP nowcast with coverage and each economy's contribution (pp).

tools.name: get_release_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming data releases that feed the nowcasts, with expected dates.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Accuracy grade (A+ to C: hit rates within ±1pp/±2pp, error vs a naive forecast, direction calls), model version history and backtest errors (RMSE, pp SAAR, by horizon) of an economy's nowcast versus official GDP.

tools.name: get_weekly_pulse
tools.description: Weekly Economic Pulse: weekly economic activity index (momentum gauge from high-frequency data such as electricity demand, freight, travel, card spending, jobless claims and job postings; standard deviations from average 13-week growth, 0 = average, not a GDP forecast). Omit economy for the latest r

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_release_calendar · Private data: get_track_record · Public sink: list_economies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_release_calendar · Private data: get_track_record · Public sink: list_economies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
